purpose: Route organization standards bundle authoring requests to the guided workflow without capturing project-only governance or writing tasks.

cases.prompt: Help us connect our company standards and company style guide to Nexus-Hub.
Organize our organization coding standards and internal conventions for every AI assistant.
Package our internal conventions and company style guide into a shared Nexus-Hub bundle.
How should we structure our company style guide and org knowledge so agents load only relevant parts?
Create an org knowledge bundle containing our team standards for the AI.
Connect our company standards as an org knowledge bundle containing team standards for the AI.
Draft a constitution with non-negotiable principles for this one repository.
Define which directories and commands our coding agent may access.
Write our secure coding standard from scratch for the engineering handbook.
cases.assert: routes to writing-editing or technical-writer, not org-standards-authoring
